description: An elderly woman in a grey-black silk gown and white lace cap sits in a carved wooden armchair, one hand raised in conversation, looking up at a circle of men in early-18th-century dress: long curled periwigs, embroidered and frock coats, lace jabots. Lit candles on brass holders and a table of open books, stacked leather volumes, quill pens and inkwells fill a dim panelled room with carved wood walls and a large gilt-framed mirror inside the scene. The painting fills the image edge to edge, with no frame or border, and no legible text: the open book pages show only dense marks. Nothing violent or nude.
